entities.summary: Tekno (b. 1992-12-17, Bauchi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bauchi and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, composers & musicians, africa.
